text:
maria: FYI I'm planning to land a module refactor that hoists the credential provider to the root module and adds a provider lockfile regen. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/842
kevin: quick question — will this change the provider source address in the lockfile? we had mirrors for the registry last time.
maria: it touches provider blocks and the lockfile. I ran a local `terraform providers lock` and saw the source rewrite for `hashicorp/random` -> `registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random`. expect a lockfile diff.
devin: that rewrite is expected. important: CI runs `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` so if you regen locally include same platform flag or we'll get CI churn.
kevin: noted. also, what about k8s secret wiring? the module used to accept `secret_name` and now the consumer expects `credentials_secret.name`.
sara: if the input shape changed we need a compatibility shim in the root module. something like:

```
variable "credentials_secret" {
  type = object({ name = string })
}

resource "kubernetes_secret" "creds" {
  metadata { name = var.credentials_secret.name }
  data = { key = var.credentials_secret_data }
}
```

we can keep the old `secret_name` var and map it for a transitional release.
maria: thanks. I'll add the shim and a migration note in the changelog. Also planning a canary rollout to staging for the infra services. tag me for the canary window.
kevin: two more checks: ensure `required_version` in root `versions.tf` matches CI (we use 1.5.7), and confirm `terraform init -upgrade` isn't run in CI on the lockfile job.
devin: CI job `tf-lockfile-check` currently does `terraform init && terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 --plugin-dir=.terraform/plugins` so it won't auto-upgrade providers. that should be safe.
infra-bot: lockfile-scan: found 1 provider path mismatch between `lock.hcl` and CI expected mirrors — see https://ci.company/job/lockfile-scan/842 :eyes:
maria: I'll re-run lock regen with the CI flags and push an update. ping me if you want to review the lockfile diff before merge.
sara: :thumbsup: also add a short note in the PR description about the secret var shim so app teams notice.
kevin: lgtm for quick checks, I'll do the canary smoke once PR is merged and the packer images in staging are rebuilt.
maria: thanks all — I'll wait for infra-bot green then merge and schedule canary. will follow up with a release note and migration steps.
